The line for 'Hochbau' starts at a value of approximately 66, not 65.

The line for 'Tiefbau' starts at a value of approximately 62.5, not 61.
The line for 'Staat insgesamt' ends on the 50% line, not at approximately 51.
The line for 'Geistiges Eigentum' ends at a value of approximately 52.5, not 54.
